ledger.x: 1451: Vasily II appoints Mikhail Yermolayevich prince of Great Perm.
1472: the seat moves from Cherdyn to the newly founded Pokcha (infobox 'Pokcha (1472-1535)').
1472: Paletsky's campaign ends the fighting: his forces defeated the Komi-Permyak forces and founded Pokcha, 'a stronghold for Moscow'.
1505: Great Perm is incorporated into the Russian state.

wars.name: Ivan III's campaign against Great Perm
wars.outcome: Fyodor Paletsky defeated the Komi-Permyak forces and founded Pokcha; Great Perm stayed dependent on Moscow and was finally incorporated in 1505 (the page's 1478 annexation is Novgorod's).

certainty.note: A taiga basin with no surveyed frontier; limits are rivers and the Urals.
